label: Before you watch.
This tape is made from real teaching, 1988–2026.
From manuals, booklets, books, newsletters, posts and news reports. The name HEDGE™ is invented. The reasons are theirs.
Every reason in it was taught to real people. Some were first taught about gay people.
You can stop it at any time.

admission.text: No one is certain what causes gender confusion.
admission.source: The Building Blocks of Gender Confusion (Reconciliation Ministries of Michigan, © 2019), p. 1 — the sentence begins "Aside from living in a fallen world, …"; the article then lists causes for three pages

sentences.text: In their own words, 2019: "No one is certain what causes gender confusion." Then they listed causes.
sentences.source: Reconciliation Ministries of Michigan, The Building Blocks of Gender Confusion, © 2019, p. 1 (the admission), pp. 2–4 (the causes it then lists) — page images read

sentences.text: First the family. Then her friends. Then the whole culture.
sentences.source: Exodus Telephone Counseling Manual, © 1988, printed p. 47 ("usually family members"); Building Blocks 2019, p. 4 ("one person in a social group"); ICCEC 2021, p. 4 and Love & Truth family post 2025 ("swept up by gender ideology")

sentences.text: Nothing was dropped. Each reason was added to the ones before.
sentences.source: Exodus manual 1988, p. 46 ("a false identity") and the Love & Truth family post 2025 ("a new, false gender identity"); Building Blocks 2019 keeps the family roots (p. 3) beside "social contagion" (p. 4)

sentences.text: Parents were told to find the wound, to watch for signs, to monitor her phone.
sentences.source: The wound: Focus on the Family 2002, p. 43 ("takes responsibility for one's parental contributions to the child's pain") and the 2019 newsletter, p. 4 (a caregiver to "explore the roots"); the signs: Focus on the Family 2002, p. 43 ("afraid your child may be struggling with gender identity", "defuse problems early on"); the phone: ERLC 2014, p. 108 ("If your children have unmonitored access to the Internet, you are a negligent parent")

sentences.text: Parenthood was made a political identity; the child, a figure to build coalitions around.
sentences.source: Transnational Institute, State of Power 2026, ch. 9, printed p. 83: movements "elevated parenthood as a political identity and the child as a sacred figure around which coalitions can be built"

sentences.text: At 18, their own post says, she is free to choose.
sentences.source: Love & Truth Network family post, 2025: "young adults will have the liberty to make their own choices" (paraphrased)

sentences.text: Her parents were told: it can take seven to ten years.
sentences.source: The same post: "It can take 7-10 years for individuals to work through the implications…"

sentences.text: The WHO: trans-related identities are not conditions of mental ill-health.
sentences.source: WHO, FAQ on gender incongruence in the ICD: "trans-related and gender diverse identities are not conditions of mental ill-health" (paraphrased into four lines; "trans-related … identities" kept)

_doc: The same words as the tape's silent break, in its order (sentence 1 holds the admission, quoted). No testimony, no names, no death or suicide figures.
